title: API and Webhooks
description: REST API v1 to integrate this workspace with other systems.
auth: Authentication: Authorization: Bearer gdu_live_… header with a key created in Settings › MCP. The key only works for this workspace, for the scopes selected on it, and only at this address.
limits: Limits per minute of your plan: {key} per key, {user} per person and {workspace} per workspace. Above that the response is 429 with Retry-After.
errors: Errors include code, message and requestId; give the requestId to support.
webhooksSoon: Coming soon: platform notifications sent to an address of yours when something happens in this workspace.

routes.listMyWorkspaces: The person's workspaces in the host's partner; with an API key, only the key's workspace.
routes.getWorkspaceOverview: Workspace summary: members, modules, executions and contract.
routes.listWorkspaceModules: Modules visible in the workspace and the state of each one.
routes.getWorkspaceUsage: Measured usage against the plan limits.
routes.listCrmContacts: CRM module contacts, newest first; search by name, email or company.
routes.createCrmContact: Creates a contact (respects the plan's contact quota).
routes.getCrmContact: A contact of the CRM module.
routes.updateCrmContact: Changes the fields sent for a contact.
routes.searchPortfolioCatalog: UCP search_catalog: search the Portfolio (text, categories, price range, pagination). Only active, public items with a price.
routes.lookupPortfolioCatalog: UCP lookup_catalog: up to 50 product, variant, SKU or handle ids; those not found are returned in messages.
routes.getPortfolioCatalogProduct: UCP get_product: one product, with option selection and availability; not found returns ucp.status = error.
routes.searchPortfolioForAgent: Customer service agent view: items released to the AI, including price-on-request ones, with the AI rules.
routes.getPortfolioItemForAgent: One item in the customer service agent view.
routes.createPortfolioItem: Creates an item with its variants (UCP fields; respects the quotas and the vertical's rules).
routes.updatePortfolioItem: Changes the fields sent for an item.
routes.updatePortfolioVariant: Changes the fields sent for a variant (price, availability, stock…).

usageDescription: Calls and errors of the keys you can see, in the last {days} days.
